newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SOLA to launch optical lens for tired eyes.
newsitem.headline: SOLA to launch optical lens for tired eyes.

text.p: International lens manufacturer SOLA International Inc's Australian design centre said on Thursday its new lens technology would be launched worldwide this month and change the way baby boomers see.

SOLA Optical said the lenses, designed in the state of South Australia over the last two years, were being manufactured here for export throughout southeast Asia at a rate of 100,000 pairs a year. The lenses were also being manufactured by SOLA's United States operation.

SOLA said the Percepta lens was the first to truly consider the different vision requirements of progressive lens wearers, people generally aged over 40 years who suffer from presbyopia or "old eyes".
"This means Percepta enhances closeup vision for which progressive lens are designed, while at the same time compensating common vision problems of shortsightedness or longsightedness," it said.
SOLA Optical commercial director David Cross said the lens was the most significant new product in the company's 37 year history.

SOLA International, which supplies spectacle lenses to more than 100 million people in more than 50 countries, was founded in 1960 in South Australia and moved its worldwide headquarters to California in 1988.
